# bitwise_ip v1.2.0 - Table of Contents

> Efficient IP address operations using bitwise arithmetic

## Modules

- [BitwiseIp](https://bitwise-ip.hexdocs.pm/BitwiseIp.md): A struct representing an IP address encoded as an integer.
- [BitwiseIp.Block](https://bitwise-ip.hexdocs.pm/BitwiseIp.Block.md): A struct representing a range of bitwise IP addresses.
- [BitwiseIp.Blocks](https://bitwise-ip.hexdocs.pm/BitwiseIp.Blocks.md): Functions for handling lists of bitwise IP blocks.
- [BitwiseIp.Mask](https://bitwise-ip.hexdocs.pm/BitwiseIp.Mask.md): Functions for handling CIDR prefix lengths as bitmasks.
